mood: Landscape suspended assemblage: a painted shoulder shell and crushed bundles surround a dark hollow; a large unraveling cable loop hangs below. Bare pleats descend past a woven cuff, wooden splice and chalk-lined mirror lip. A separate narrow fold bears a blue, cyan and lime painted bulge. Thin suspension lines cross a luminous field with one architectural edge; ragged lower ends hang free.
material_language: Crushed silver-gray and tan corrugated sheets with broken green and rusty orange-red paint.
Dark twisted cable and black-and-cream ribbed weave, distinct from the surrounding bare pleats.
Rough wood with gray, pink and blue paint at a projecting assembly joint.
A reflective lip with chalk-like fragments; a small blue fold with white-edged cyan and lime paint.
lighting: Strong pale backlight outlines ragged hems and suspension lines; deep cavities stay dark, with restrained frontal fill revealing paint and weave.
object_inventory: A broad green-and-rust ribbed shoulder shell encloses a dark hollow.
A large dark twisted cable loop unravels into branching strands.
A black-and-cream woven cuff carries overlapping curved ribbed bands.
A rough wooden splice projects beneath gray, pink and blue paint.
A small mirror lip rises from a folded pocket of chalk-like fragments.
A narrow blue fold bears a white-edged cyan-and-lime rounded bulge.
negative_constraints: No text, labels, URLs, logos, numbering, cards, interface chrome, pins, target rings or debug outlines.
No pasted source images, reconstructed triplet of vertical bodies or miniature replicas of the supporting artworks.
No floor-supported objects, full gallery reconstruction, landscape metaphor or isolated macro-texture field.

Keep the measured landscape aspect; no portrait conversion, framed picture treatment or crop that removes hanging ends.
No invented animation motion, playback evidence, reflected scenery or decorative symbols standing in for physical features.
